_meta.citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). India Geopolitical Risk Monitor. https://igrm.in/
_meta.what: Every number that did not go this project's way, compiled from the payloads where each lives. Read live from those payloads at build time, never hand-typed, so a row that stops being true stops being published.
_meta.why: Anyone can publish good numbers. The reason to believe the flattering ones is that the unflattering ones are computed by the same pipeline on the same schedule -- and this file is where they stand together instead of being scattered across seven payloads.

findings.finding: Fusing four sources made detection worse, not better
findings.number: 2 of 29 episodes detected (hit rate 0.069) vs 24 of 29 for the press channel alone
findings.reading: the pre-registered four-source gauge detects a twelfth of what the single press channel does; sophistication is not accuracy

findings.finding: Placebo channels overlap real episodes far above zero
findings.number: 52 of 115 placebo episodes (45.2%) overlap real ones; chance under random placement is ~35.6%
findings.reading: part of every channel's signal is general news volume, and the excess over chance is ~10 points, not 45

findings.finding: A naive any-channel detector nearly matches the registered hit rate
findings.number: naive 26 of 29 vs registered 24 of 29; chance 6.8
findings.reading: detection alone is cheap; the channel attribution is what the apparatus actually contributes

findings.finding: The index tracks English-language attention, not Indian-language attention
findings.number: English Wikipedia leads Hindi on 5 of 5 channels, in both levels and changes, with no channel in the other direction
findings.reading: the construct is Anglophone press salience of India; the name understates the qualifier

findings.finding: Two of four historical channels failed their own pre-registered test and were withheld
findings.number: gulf_energy r=0.153, us_trade r=0.216 against a registered floor of 0.6
findings.reading: the withholding rule is the contribution; publishing them anyway would have retracted it

findings.finding: No sector shows a return sensitivity that survives multiple-comparison correction
findings.number: 0 of 39 cells significant at Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 10% on first computation
findings.reading: with this episode set, sector sensitivity to salience episodes is indistinguishable from zero once the search is paid for

findings.finding: The market moves before the press does
findings.number: largest association at lag -8: VIX-percentile changes tend to precede attention changes (association, not causation)
findings.reading: this index is not an early-warning system for anything priced; whatever it is for, it is not that

findings.finding: Measured precision is uncalibrated and low on two channels
findings.number: author labels 16 of 100; machine agreement 0.875 on n=16
findings.reading: precision claims wait for the human calibration to reach its registered threshold

findings.finding: The headline is sensitive to a calibration constant on one channel
findings.number: china_east 7-day score moves up to 25.63 points across defensible splice ratios
findings.reading: the primary series is frozen while the founder decides; the sensitivity is published rather than absorbed
